parsed.explanation: Article 489 is not tangential: rights reports document it and morality provisions used against trans people for gender expression, with wide police discretion and arbitrary detention. An outed visitor faces possible arrest/prosecution, police humiliation (forced genital examination allegation; filming and document posting), public outing, violence, and no anti-discrimination or state-protection route. Hostile officials and religious authorities, blocked LGBTIQ organisations, absent visitor shelter/healthcare, and no documented safe local enclaves mean no effective recourse. Some selective positives—acquittals and arrests after a 2022 beating—show courts can act, but not for systemic trans risk; rule-of-law can enforce hostility. Evidence is partly thin/unconfirmed, yet current structural pattern sits below facility-ban-only risk and above near-certain custodial-campaign levels. High risk.
